item.title: Show HN: Grafana agent observability for Hermes Agent
item.description:
📝 grafana-agento11y-hermes Grafana Agent Observability plugin for Hermes Agent. yaml, and the credentials from the Agent Observability setup page. Manual pip install grafana-agento11y-hermes Install into the same Python environment hermes runs from (which hermes to check).
